$comment: Shared activation windows. Read by BOTH the server service and the client engine so the two cannot drift. Keyed by effect/theme (stable across countries) rather than by holiday id, because ids are generated per country+date (e.g. ng-national-day-2026-10-01).
$intensity: Presentation strength per theme, shared so the API can report the same value the client renders. 'subtle' = ambient wash and edge only, no particles; 'restrained' = a light particle field; 'expressive' = a fuller, still-capped field.
